title: What is the 'true' size of the continuum

problemStatement.plain: Formalization extending an existing formalization: What is the 'true' size of the continuum.

knowledge.progressSummary: AXIOM HUNT: Eliminated 4 of 8 axioms (8→4). Proved aleph_omega_cof_eq_omega from Mathlib (Cardinal.cof_aleph + Ordinal.card_omega0), proved bounding_le_dominating from dominating_implies_unbounded via infimum reasoning, proved easton_regular_consistency (conclusion was True), converted MartinsAxiom from axiom to opaque. Remaining 4 axioms are deep (Konig, diagonalization, cardinality, forcing).
